name: Marinara Extender
description: Injects scoped persistent memory from the Marinara Extender sidecar while the prompt is being assembled, so recall is scored against the message being answered rather than the previous turn. Requires the Marinara Extender sidecar running locally. In Roleplay and Game, add the Agent under Chat Settings -> Agents -> Misc Agents. Conversation mode has no agent picker in the Engine, so it is governed by the sidecar setting instead (on by default; MARINARA_EXTENDER_CONVERSATION_MEMORY=0 to disable).
author: TC Lowe
